# Researcher codebook — delivered output columns

<!-- GENERATED by web/scripts/generate_output_codebook_artifacts.mts from
     web/schema/chronicle-output-columns.yaml — do not edit by hand. -->

Column-by-column semantics of the App Usage and Screen Usage CSVs the
preprocessor delivers. Names in `{braces}` are stamped with the option
value at processing time. "Present when" refers to processing options
(snake_case names as in the settings contract); blank means the column is
always present. Columns marked *filter-dependent* are defined over the
non-filtered app universe, so enabling the filter file legitimately
changes their values.

## App Usage output

| Column | Type | Units | Present when | Description |
|--------|------|-------|--------------|-------------|
| `study_id` | string |  |  | Study identifier as it appears in the raw Chronicle export, preserved unchanged. |
| `study_name` | string |  |  | Your own study label, entered in the app (the study_name option); not from the raw data. |
| `participant_id` | string |  |  | Participant identifier from the raw Chronicle export. |
| `possible_device_model` | string |  |  | Device model inferred from the raw export's device metadata, when present. |
| `username` | string |  |  | Chronicle account username from the raw export. |
| `event_timestamp` | timestamp |  |  | Timestamp of the raw event that opened this usage row, in the row's output timezone. *Vocabulary: Android UsageEvents.Event#getTimeStamp.* |
| `date` | date |  |  | Calendar date of the row's start, after timezone handling. |
| `timezone` | string |  |  | IANA timezone the row's timestamps are expressed in (after the selected/primary filter or conversion). |
| `app_package_name` | string |  |  | Android application package (e.g. com.google.android.youtube). For screen rows, a screen-session pseudo-package. *Vocabulary: Android UsageEvents.Event#getPackageName.* |
| `application_label` | string |  |  | Human-readable app name recorded by Chronicle at collection time. |
| `genreId_scraped` | string |  | use_app_codebook | Play-Store genre scraped for the package (codebook passthrough). |
| `broad_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook and include_category_column | Single broad category chosen from the codebook's per-source category columns (first non-empty in preference order). |
| `codebook_application_label` | string |  | use_app_codebook | App name as recorded in the app codebook (may differ from the device-reported label). |
| `bcm_play_store_genreId` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — Play-Store genre id for the package. |
| `bcm_play_store_genre` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — Play-Store genre name. |
| `bcm_play_store_broad_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — broad category derived from the Play-Store genre. |
| `bcm_play_store_developer` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — Play-Store developer name. |
| `bcm_play_store_free` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — whether the Play-Store listing is free. |
| `bcm_play_store_rating` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — Play-Store content rating. |
| `bcm_play_store_downloads` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM codebook — Play-Store download-count bracket. |
| `usc_broad_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | USC codebook — broad category. |
| `usc_genreId` | string |  | use_app_codebook | USC codebook — genre id. |
| `umich_child_app_category_code` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — child-app category code. |
| `umich_child_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — child-app category. |
| `umich_adult_app_category_code` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — adult-app category code. |
| `umich_adult_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — adult-app category. |
| `umich_free` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — whether the app is free. |
| `umich_gambling_app` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — gambling-app indicator. |
| `umich_inappropriate_app` | string |  | use_app_codebook | UMich codebook — inappropriate-app indicator. |
| `babyemu_genreId_scraped` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — scraped genre id. |
| `babyemu_genreId_manual` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — manually assigned genre id. |
| `babyemu_broad_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — broad category. |
| `babyemu_medium_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — medium-granularity category. |
| `babyemu_fine_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — fine-granularity category. |
| `babyemu_alternate_fine_app_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — alternate fine category. |
| `babyemu_kids` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BabyEMU codebook — kids-app indicator. |
| `bcm_cnrc_heuristic_category` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM CNRC codebook — heuristic category assignment. |
| `bcm_cnrc_categorization_source` | string |  | use_app_codebook | BCM CNRC codebook — which source produced the heuristic category. |
| `codebook_dataset` | string |  | use_app_codebook | Which codebook dataset the category row came from. |
| `interaction_type` | string |  |  | Row kind — "App Usage" for reconstructed foreground sessions, "Screen Usage" for screen-on sessions, "Filtered App Usage" and related marker types for rows retained as timing witnesses. Derived from Android UsageEvents transitions (Activity Resumed/Paused/Stopped and screen events). *Vocabulary: Android UsageEvents event types (P&T pairing vocabulary).* |
| `start_timestamp` | timestamp |  |  | Session start, in the row's output timezone. |
| `stop_timestamp` | timestamp |  |  | Session end, in the row's output timezone. |
| `duration_seconds` | float | seconds |  | Session length (stop − start) in seconds. |
| `duration_minutes` | float | minutes |  | Session length in minutes (duration_seconds × 1/60). |
| `any_app_usage_flags` | list_text |  |  | Quality flags for the row rendered as a list literal — ">N-HR TIME GAP" when the preceding data gap crossed a long_data_time_gap threshold, ">N-HR APP USAGE" when the session itself crossed a long_usage_duration threshold. |
| `data_time_gap_hours` | float | hours |  | Hours since the previous raw data row from the device (device-silent gap preceding this row). |
| `day` | integer |  |  | Weekday number of the row's date, 1 = Sunday … 7 = Saturday. |
| `weekdayMF` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when the date falls Monday–Friday. |
| `weekdayMTh` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when the date falls Monday–Thursday. |
| `weekdaySuTh` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when the date falls Sunday–Thursday. |
| `hour` | integer |  |  | Local hour of day (0–23) of the row's start. |
| `quarter` | integer |  |  | Calendar quarter (1–4) of the row's date. |
| `valid_app_new_engage_30s` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when this session begins a new engagement — ≥30 s since the previous usage — computed over VALID (non-filtered) apps only. *Filter-dependent.* *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `valid_app_new_engage_custom_{custom_app_engagement_duration}s` | binary_flag |  |  | Same as valid_app_new_engage_30s with your custom engagement gap (the custom_app_engagement_duration option, stamped into the header). *Filter-dependent.* *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `valid_app_switched_app` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when the session's app differs from the previous valid-app session (an app switch). *Filter-dependent.* *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `valid_app_usage_time_gap_hours` | float | hours |  | Hours since the previous valid-app session ended. *Filter-dependent.* |
| `any_app_new_engage_30s` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when this session begins a new engagement (≥30 s since previous usage), computed over ALL apps including filtered ones. *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `any_app_new_engage_custom_{custom_app_engagement_duration}s` | binary_flag |  |  | Same as any_app_new_engage_30s with your custom engagement gap. *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `any_app_switched_app` | binary_flag |  |  | 1 when the session's app differs from the previous session over all apps. *Vocabulary: EYES manual engagement metrics.* |
| `any_app_usage_time_gap_hours` | float | hours |  | Hours since the previous session (any app) ended. |
| `preprocessor_version` | string |  |  | Version of the preprocessing engine that produced the file. |
| `datetime_of_preprocessing` | timestamp |  |  | UTC wall-clock stamp of the processing run (one stamp per file per session). |
| `usage_layer` | string |  | model_concurrent_usage | "primary" when the app was the sole foreground app for the row's sub-interval, "secondary" when it ran underneath another app (split-screen or picture-in-picture). |

Derived from Android UsageEvents transitions (Activity Resumed/Paused/Stopped and screen events). *Vocabulary: Android UsageEvents event types (P&T pairing vocabulary).* |
